bio.text: Jeff Wilson, a Champaign County Board member, won the Republican primary for Illinois' 13th Congressional District on March 17, 2026, and will face Democratic incumbent Nikki Budzinski in the November 3 general election.
In February 2026, St. Louis Public Radio described him as a former naval submariner and retired nuclear engineer who lives in Mahomet.

sources.title: Jeff Wilson believes he's the Republican to flip Illinois' 13th Congressional District
Budzinski, Wilson to face off in general election for Illinois' 13th congressional district
